reply:
Good afternoon Chidi. I looked into this before resending, and I'm glad I did — your bank actually reports the payment as successful.

- Transfer: TRF-INV-88 — ₦250,000 to Access Bank, 0234567891
- Bank confirmation: "Credited to the recipient account" on 21 November 2026 at 14:02 UTC (15:02 Nigerian time)
- Bank session ID: 000014261121140211000088

Our internal dashboard showed "failed" due to a status update issue, but the bank has confirmed the money landed in your account. Because of that, I have not resent the ₦250,000 — doing so would have paid you twice, and we'd have needed to recover the duplicate.

Please check your Access Bank account balance and statement. If the credit doesn't appear or you can't trace it with the session ID above, let me know and we'll escalate to the bank together. If all is in order, invoice INV-88 can be considered settled — apologies for the confusion the status display caused.
